description: Issue #839 (maintainer ruling #833 rule 3, "nothing shadows"): `define forward … return 55 … end` then `print fd`, issue #787's original host-crash repro. `define forward` is `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/error-model.md:125`) at phase-1 registration (`spec/execution-model.md:82-89`), so nothing runs and the event stream is empty. The evaluator invariant lives in `packages/runtime/src/heritage-alias-chokepoint.test.mjs`, which assembles an `Environment` by hand (registration cannot admit one) and asserts that the node handed to `callProcedure` already spells `forward` while its `source_span` still covers the two columns of `fd`. That is the surface the crash is still reachable through: `evaluate` and `createEnvironment` are public API a host can drive directly. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.

diagnostics.message: forward does something, it doesn't make a value. i need a value here.
forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
